the premise is like sorta shonen esque like there's a power system yadda yadda but kinda leaning on much more mature themes and execution? so in this world, killing is very normalized, so being like a bounty hunter or an assassin for example is government regulated and is considered a socially acceptable career path akin to law enforcement (although tbh it's probably more socially acceptable than law enforcement is in our world atp [AND RIGHTFULLY SO])
9:07 PM
but so basically the first chapter opens with our main character (blaise) having a flashback where he's having a convo with this girl (sierra) and they are sort of alluding to some tragedy that occurred where blaise is sort of holding sierra responsible for it and sierra has like a very apathetic attitude to it all and it ends with no conclusion. fast forward 5 years later to present day, blaise is on death row but is offered an opportunity to join the bounty hunters as part of like a reform program, where they have a battle royale esque entrance exam and the most promising candidates earn amnesty and are conscripted into the bounty hunters. blaise is placed in a team with some goody two shoes people who were falsely accused of his crimes, contrasting his really cynical and jaded attitude. during the exam, a thief breaks onto the exam grounds unexpectedly. blaise's teammates notice the intruder and elect to chase after him because it's the right thing to do, but blaise wants to focus on the exam because of his more pragmatic view. after they leave without him, blaise eventually has a change of hard and goes after his teammates, but they've already been defeated by the thief, named johan. blaise and johan fight but blaise despite being a talented fighter is kind of getting his ass kicked UNTIL he has an epiphany and resolves that his purpose in this world is just the simple rhetoric of putting away bad guys and being a cog in the machine, and he doesn't need to have some greater conviction for doing so. following this, he gets a power boost in his last stand and then johan kills him and johan is the real main character
